newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jet fuel prices hoisted by boisterous NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jet fuel prices hoisted by boisterous NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices were hoisted almost 2.50 cents a gallon higher on the shoulders of NYMEX futures Monday, players said, as distillates continued to win bullish favor based upon low domestic stocks.
New York Harbor 54-grade was offered at 0.50 cent over the print, stable with Friday diffs, while low-sulfur 55-grade fuel also remained steady at 3.10 cents above the screen, traders said.
Gulf 54-grade, was little changed at 1.75 cents below the print, players said.
